pairs.reason: Both solutions must complete independent FULL/STA and have zero overuse.

caveats: VPR process after identical input pre-read; pack/place excluded and fixed; RRG XML load, lookahead, routing, native FULL and STA included. Independent original readback reported separately in workflow.

Uses completed main small-lane pool [48,49,50,51] and completed preparation pool [56,57,58,59]. May overlap main CPU matrix, MultiQueue pilot and candidate compilation on disjoint CPU pools. Shared host and memory, no exclusivity claimed.
2D cases: three fixed-seed repetitions; 3D native channel widths: one exploratory pair each with equal 600-second cap. Failure/timeout is retained, no speedup ratio for failed solutions.
Build-cache improvements are not routing-kernel acceleration; cache reuse is provided equally.
Failed routes are excluded from speedup ratios and remain part of the robustness result.
